revision_history.author: project_manager
revision_history.description: Reconciled the expectation with the rule this scenario declares. declared detector 'Production authorization governance checker' -> rule id 'production_authorization_governance_checker'; expected severity medium -> high; expected category verification -> process; expected description de-duplicated: it had been copy-pasted from SCN-MUT-020 and did not describe this scenario's defect. Severity and category are the rule's values and are authoritative; the rule was not changed to fit this fixture. severity raised from medium to high and the category changed from verification to process. The injected defect is a governance claim - production_authorized true with no human approval - which is a process defect, not a verification one, and a claim of production authorisation is a high-severity governance defect. The rule is authoritative and neither its severity nor its category was changed to fit the fixture.The scenario's injected defect, its affected artifacts and its declared detector rule are unchanged. This expectation had never been checked: the scenario harness matched any finding of the right severity on the right artifact id, so a standing finding on the same artifact satisfied it. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000032.

patch.description: Promote artifact to production_authorized without human approval

expected_finding.description: artifact FB2-SAF-SGO-000001 has production_authorized=true but human_approval_status != approved
